The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and stripes along its back and sides. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the eyes are visible. Short, stout limbs are planted on the ground, supporting the cylindrical body. The tail extends towards the right edge of the frame.
